faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What you wonder about pool equipment, orders and pricing.

items.question: How can I get a price quote?
items.answer: Submit your request by phone (0212 616 55 20 / 0546 254 14 54), email (info@batech.com.tr), WhatsApp or the contact form on the site. If you share product name, quantity and project details, we will prepare a quote as soon as possible.

items.question: How does the order process work?
items.answer: First you contact us and state your needs. After the quote and catalog are presented, we take your order with your approval. Once products are ready, we ship by courier or our own vehicles. We are with you for installation and technical support.

items.question: How can I download the product catalog?
items.answer: You can download our PDF catalog from the "Download Catalog" button on the site. We recommend contacting us for current prices and technical information.

items.question: What voltage do your pool lighting products run on?
items.answer: Our pool lights mostly run on 12V DC safety voltage. Technical specifications are given on product detail pages and in the catalog. Different voltage options can be offered for special projects.

items.question: Can I place wholesale or project-based orders?
items.answer: Yes. We offer special pricing and delivery terms for distributors, contractors and project-based orders. Just contact us and state your needs.

items.question: What are the warranty and return conditions?
items.answer: Warranty period and conditions vary by product group. Contact us for returns and exchanges; we will inform you according to product and order status.
